title: Bitcoin sits out stock rebound as ETF outflows extend to fourth day
content: Bitcoin held steady near $74,000 as Tuesday's hot inflation figure lifted the odds on a U.S. interest-rate increase to around 90%. ETF outflows extended to a fourth day and liquidations jumped.

title: Kraken's xStocks adds 200 UK and EU shares as its assets top $1.1 billion
content: Payward says xStocks holds over $1.1 billion. Each token is backed by a share but gives no ownership of the underlying company.

title: Bitcoin holds steady as CoreWeave earnings revive AI outlook, Anthropic said to raise IPO valuation
content: CoreWeave’s revenue surge lifted AI infrastructure stocks and Nasdaq futures, while bitcoin was little changed over 24 hours.

title: Warren: What is White House doing to prevent a repeat of teleprompter's Trump bets?
content: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren argued the administration is not doing enough about staff insider trading, questioning whether CFTC enforcement action was sufficient.

title: Former NYSE president says stock issuers hold the key to tokenization as Bullish builds its platform
content: Stacey Cunningham, who recently joined digital asset platform Bullish as President, sees the company’s planned Equiniti acquisition and focus on stock issuers as key to its tokenization ambitions.

title: Kraken parent adds over 200 tokenized UK and EU stocks to xStocks
content: The expansion adds more than 200 tokenized UK and EU equities, including all 40 companies in Germany’s DAX index, as xStocks plans further expansion into Hong Kong.

title: Bitcoin short-term holders send 47K BTC to exchanges at a loss
content: Bitcoin fell to an 11-week low of $72,670 after slipping below short-term holders’ average cost basis of about $75,700, according to CryptoQuant.

title: Bitget Wallet reports sevenfold jump in crypto phishing risk alerts
content: The wallet flagged about 37,000 signing requests a week for phishing in Q3 and said better monitoring likely contributed to the increase.

title: Bitmine posts $6.3B net loss for fiscal 2026 as Ether prices slide
content: Bitmine booked $6.2 billion in unrealized losses on digital assets. It held 6.07 million ETH on Sunday, or 4.97% of Ether’s supply.

title: ECB warns legislative delays could postpone digital euro launch
content: ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone warned EU lawmakers that delays in finalizing digital euro legislation could push back its potential 2029 rollout.

title: Avalanche Won Over the NYSE. Now It Has to ‘Capture Value’ for AVAX
content: The New York Stock Exchange will use Avalanche infrastructure, but experts say that won't necessarily boost AVAX's price.

title: Prisoner Jailed for 8 Years Over $2.7M Crypto Theft Plot Run From His Cell
content: Robert Barr planned to have accomplices force a crypto investor to install remote-access software so he could drain the wallet from prison.

title: Bitcoin Miner HIVE Eyes $45 Million in Annual Revenue From AI Deal
content: The Bitcoin miner says its Boden facility could generate $45 million annually, but a June letter of intent remains nonbinding as executives negotiate financing and customer protections for the project.

title: Trump Media Posts $410 Million Profit. Bitcoin Gains Did the Heavy Lifting
content: Truth Social’s parent booked $409.7 million in quarterly income largely from crypto investments, even as its stock remained more than 94% below its March 2024 peak.

title: Nvidia Erases 2026 Gains as Republicans Threaten Jensen Huang With Subpoena
content: The chipmaker has erased its 2026 gains as a suspected Chinese espionage case brings fresh scrutiny of CEO Jensen Huang.

title: LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds
content: Bitcoin Magazine LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds LNbits released version 1.7.0 on November 10 as an urgent security update following active attacks that began November 8. Operators must upgrade before restarting servers as prior versions put funds at risk of theft. This post LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .

title: Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin
content: Bitcoin Magazine Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin Rep. Ron Reynolds filed House Bill 815 on Monday, allowing each Texas city or county to put up to $10 million of public money into bitcoin starting Sept. 1, 2027. This post Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review
content: Bitcoin Magazine Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review Poland's Sejm passed a sanctions bill Friday that lets the interior minister freeze bitcoin and bank funds of people on a national list, and a court appeal would not pause the freeze. This post Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Canaan (CAN) Swings to an $8 Million Profit on Bitcoin Gains as Rig Sales Collapse 96%
content: Bitcoin Magazine Canaan (CAN) Swings to an $8 Million Profit on Bitcoin Gains as Rig Sales Collapse 96% Canaan's mining-machine sales fell to $4.8 million from $118.6 million a year earlier, but a $51.9 million fair-value gain turned an operating loss into $8.0 million of net income.
